.peer-ai/work/SB-3.json.title: Split unevenly, by weight
.peer-ai/work/SB-3.json.goal: A bill can be split by each person's weight, such as the number of dishes they had, and the shares still add up to the cent.
acceptance: Given a bill of 1000 cents and weights 2, 1 and 1, when it's split, then the shares are 500, 250 and 250.

Given a bill that doesn't divide exactly by the weights, when it's split, then the shares add up to the bill, and each leftover cent goes to the person whose exact share lost the most to rounding, the earliest on a tie.
Given a weight that is zero, negative or not a whole number, or nobody to pay, when it's split, then it's refused with a clear message.
Given everyone has the same weight, when it's split, then the shares are exactly what split gives today.
